runs.content: Build-A-Bear at ~6x earnings and a ~3.6% yield near its 52-week low, a direct Burry long whose new CEO is reversing the pre-made plush push. LMT was exited as a capacity trim (−4.53%, −$45; weakest position, no thesis break). No stop/T1/T2 triggers; RIGL is $1.52 and CVX $2.51 from T1. Portfolio net P&L: +$2,067 (+2.68% on $77,000).

Salesforce (NYSE, $229.13) was bought as the day's momentum pick. It is up ~34% over 3 months, pulled back ~5% to its rising 50-day average, with Agentforce ARR above $1.5B and fresh analyst upgrades as tech rebounded. HPQ was exited on a thesis break (IDC Q3 PC shipments −31% YoY, FY27 guidance withheld) at +20.75%; blended with its T1 it closes at +$222 (+22.2%), the first winning close since July. No stop/T1/T2 triggers; RIGL is $1.25 from T1 and CVX is $5.53 from T1. Portfolio net P&L: +$1,914 (+2.52% on $76,000).
